exposure: BFT counseling during pregnancy or immediately after delivery
cohort: The participants were 415 early post-partum mothers in Fuzhou, China.
finding: The overall prevalence of effective BFT was 70.4%, and was significantly higher among participants with higher education, those who attended ANC, had BFT knowledge, and received BFT counseling, while experiencing breast problems was associated with a lower likelihood of effective BFT.
